$comment: Labelled chat messages for `npm run bench:ai` (see src/scripts/bench_ai.ts).
Fields: id, lang (en|fr), text, expect ('safe' = must not produce a card, 'flag' = must), optional category (string or list of acceptable categories)
(the category a correct verdict should use), optional history (earlier messages from the same user), note.
No real slurs are written here on purpose: hate items use dehumanizing phrasing and the literal placeholder [slur].
'safe' items include the traps the prompt is tuned against (casual 'hate'/'kill', dots in version numbers, fragments, repetition).
